text:
:= by
  let b := Sup s
  use b
  · intro x
    intro hx
    have : b ∈ s ∨ b ∉ s := or.inl (mem_Sup_iff.1 hx)
    cases this with h1 h2
    · contradiction
    · exact lt_Sup_iff.2 (hx h2)
  · intro y
    intro hy
    have : b ∈ t ∨ b ∉ t := or.inl (mem_Inf_iff.1 hy)
    cases this with h1 h2
    · contradiction
    · exact gt_Inf_iff.2 (hy h2)
